relevance_note: A review of published HA20 patients that gives individual-level detail for a few previously reported patients, e.g. 'The second case was a 6-year-old Japanese boy.'
method_note: Review (Kadowaki 2021) summarising published HA20 patients at group level (Table 1: counts and percentages for East Asia vs other regions; no per-patient table). Rows were created only for previously published patients the text describes with individual-level facts: the Hodgkin lymphoma patient (10), the two allogeneic HCT recipients (English boy, Japanese boy; text cites '(31, 47)' for both, so the per-person reference is not separated and both carry '(31, 47)'), and the autologous HCT recipient with CNS vasculitis (30). Labels 'ref (31, 47) patient' (English boy) and 'ref (31, 47) patient 2' (Japanese boy) follow the order in which the Discussion describes them. Ages '14-year-old' and '6-year-old' were recorded as age at last evaluation; the paper does not say whether they are ages at HCT or at report. Not given rows: the single East Asian patient with elevated ISG expression (47) and the single East Asian patient treated with canakinumab (47), who may be the Japanese HCT boy but the paper does not say so explicitly; variants listed only per reference or per family (Cys243Tyr (45), Glu192Lys (18), Met476Ile (20), Arg183X in two families (22, 27), Arg87X (21, 42)) and unattributed variants (p.Asn102Ser, c.487-1G>A, p.Val309dup, Phe127Cys SNP), since no individual is identified. No variant rows: no described person has a printed variant tied to them. 'enteropathy', 'bowel disease', 'cell depletion' and 'hepatitis' were not mapped to the checklist items GI inflammation, autoimmune cytopenia or autoimmune hepatitis because the paper does not state inflammation or autoimmunity for them; psoriasis was counted under skin lesions; insulin-dependent DM under type 1 diabetes; Hodgkin lymphoma not counted as lymphoproliferation. n_patients_reported left null: the authors give 74 East Asian and 51 other-region patients separately, not a total. Built with a short Python script in scratch; all spans checked verbatim by script.
